#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

export VAULT_ADDR="{{vault_addr}}"
[ -z "${VAULT_TOKEN:-}" ] && VAULT_TOKEN=$(vault login -method=oidc -token-only)
export VAULT_TOKEN

resp=$(vault read -format=json database/creds/{{db_role}})
user=$(echo "$resp" | jq -r '.data.username')
pass=$(echo "$resp" | jq -r '.data.password')
lease=$(echo "$resp" | jq -r '.lease_id')
ttl=$(echo "$resp" | jq -r '.lease_duration')

echo "DB_USER=$user"
echo "DB_PASS=$pass"
echo "# lease $lease ttl ${ttl}s"
echo "# renew: vault lease renew $lease"
summary_zh: Vault 取 DB 動態憑證含 lease 資訊
